verdict.rationale: Brex documents an MCP server and AI agents (audit/review agents, Brex AI writing memos and filing reimbursements) that let users interact via natural language for expense/finance tasks, indicating some natural-language operability. However, evidence doesn't show broad natural-language command coverage across the whole platform (e.g., cards, budgets, bill pay setup) beyond expense-related AI agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language commands working end-to-end, broader coverage beyond expense management/MCP.
